usedFor: Shopify holds checkouts, and NiftyImages keeps email image data, so “Abandoned Checkout” can feed “Add a Data to Store Record”.

bestTemplate.name: “Abandoned Checkout” in Shopify, then “Add a Data to Store Record” in NiftyImages
bestTemplate.why: The action adds or updates a record, so the shopper's details are ready for personalized images.

watchOut: “Abandoned Checkout” is polling, so the record is saved after a scheduled check.
